verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the SDK is built to 'run untrusted code securely in isolated environments' with VM-based per-sandbox isolation, stdin-based input to avoid shell injection, and outbound request interception—directly addressing safe execution of untrusted AI-generated code. Community discussion validates real-world adoption and interest (competing with e2b), though notes caveats like limited network egress control and no built-in idle auto-destroy, which are meaningful but don't negate core capability.
